Job Opportunity: Assistant Professor in Computer Applications at Don Bosco College, Panjim, Goa🎓💼

Applications are invited for faculty positions on a contract and lecture basis. Here are the key details you need to know:

Position Details: Assistant Professor in Computer Applications with 2 contract basis vacancies and 1 lecture basis vacancy available.

Essential Qualifications: Minimum 55% marks at the Bachelor's and Master's Degree level or equivalent grade with a good academic record.

Eligibility Test: Candidates should have passed the eligibility test for lecturers conducted by UGC/CSIR such as NET/SET or a similar UGC-accredited test.

Eligible Degrees: MSc in Computer Science / MSc (IT), MCA, ME (Computer Engineering), MTech (Computer Technology), or MTech (Computer Science & Engineering).

Degree Consistency & Residency: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's and Master's degree in the same subject, along with 15 years of residence in Goa.

Temporary Basis Option: If candidates who have passed the required eligibility tests are not available or suitable, individuals fulfilling other conditions can be considered for appointment on a purely temporary basis until the end of the academic year.

How to Apply:

* Download and use the application format available on the official college website.

* Submit the application along with your full bio-data to the Director, Don Bosco College, MG Road, Panjim, Goa - 403 001.
